purpose: Frozen validation contract for deterministic spatial partitioning and bounded streaming admission toward a Milky-Way-scale catalog.

coordinate_domain.frame_requirement: one declared galactocentric Cartesian frame per catalog snapshot
coordinate_domain.epoch_requirement: one explicit epoch and time-scale policy per snapshot
coordinate_domain.source_provenance_requirement: frame, epoch, transform receipt, source id, uncertainty/covariance, selection, license, and ingest revision live outside geometric cell identity

reference_scales.note: Catalogue size reference only; Gaia DR3 is not a complete census of all Milky Way objects.

correctness_invariants: out-of-domain coordinates reject rather than wrap or clamp
same coordinate and depth produce the same cell identity
ancestor/descendant relation is determined only from depth and Morton prefix
selected tile count never exceeds the configured maximum
admitted records never exceed the configured maximum
admitted resident bytes never exceed the configured maximum
pinned content that cannot fit causes an explicit error
input permutation does not change the selected tile plan
geometric key does not imply scientific certainty, source completeness, or currentness

benchmark_cases.workload: domain minima, maxima, axis planes and adjacent coordinate values
prioritized optional tiles plus pinned target tiles under three simultaneous hard limits
identical candidate set in several input orders
generate 1,000,000 seeded positions and cell keys in release mode
generate 10,000,000 seeded positions; include RSS and output digest
project storage, build throughput and cold/warm regional traversal at billion-row scale

performance_reporting.proposed_performance_target: Establish a checked-in CPU baseline first; set throughput and latency gates only after reproducible measurements on a documented reference machine.

external_comparison_baselines.capability: working-draft hierarchical progressive survey tiling across spatial and potential time/frequency dimensions
hierarchical spatial content delivery and screen-space-error based refinement
catalog rendering with octree-based catalog groups and residency controls

claim_ceiling: This is a cell-key and budget-planning primitive, not a complete galaxy renderer.
The fixture is a workload contract, not a benchmark result.
No claim that Gaia measured sources equal all objects in the Milky Way.
No comparison win is claimed until equivalent inputs, resolutions, camera traces, visibility criteria and hardware are independently measured.
